clauses.reason: Sec. 1 states that the rates of basic pay or salaries of the statutory pay systems (as defined in 5 U.S.C. 5302(1)), as adjusted under 5 U.S.C. 5303(b), are set forth on the attached schedules. It is a standing pay-rate command with no end date of its own. EO 13332 (signed 2004-03-03; 69 FR 10891, Federal Register of March 8, 2004) says in its Sec. 8, headed "Prior Order Superseded.", "Executive Order 13322 of December 30, 2003, is superseded." The sentence has no later effective date or condition, so the supersession is recorded as taking effect on its signing date, 2004-03-03. Alternative reading disclosed: Sec. 7 of EO 13332 makes its own schedules effective on the same dates as EO 13322's ("Schedule 8 is effective on January 1, 2004." and, for the other schedules, the first day of the first pay period beginning on or after January 1, 2004), so the rates of EO 13322 may be read as replaced as of those January 2004 dates; no source cited in this claim states that the supersession itself took effect before 2004-03-03.

research_rationale:
EO 13322 (signed 2003-12-30; 69 FR 231, Federal Register of January 2, 2004) is the 2004 federal pay-adjustment order. Its Sec. 1 to 6 state the pay schedules (statutory pay systems, Senior Executive Service, executive and other salaries, uniformed services, locality payments, administrative law judges), Sec. 7 gives their effective dates and Sec. 8 supersedes EO 13282 as amended by EO 13291. EO 13332 (signed 2004-03-03; 69 FR 10891) says in its Sec. 8 that "Executive Order 13322 of December 30, 2003, is superseded." The end is recorded as 2004-03-03 with the later schedule-effective dates disclosed. The three selected machine searches (U.S. Code, eCFR and the OFR order catalog) are used only for the coverage each states; none yields an earlier ending instrument, and EO 13332 is the only instrument that ends this order.

savings.reason: EO 13332 contains no savings clause for EO 13322, but it makes its own schedules effective on the same dates as this order's: "Schedule 8 is effective on January 1, 2004." and "The other schedules contained herein are effective on the first day of the first pay period beginning on or after January 1, 2004." Pay for pay periods before the supersession was earned under the schedules of EO 13322 or of its replacement and is a completed historical consequence, and the supersession of EO 13282 in Sec. 8 of this order is a completed effect; no continuing independent command of EO 13322 survives the supersession.
